title: EXPRESS: When AI Assists at the Frontline: External and Internal Marketing Effects in the Context of Banking Mortgages
eligible_reason: Single treatment date. Studies 1 and 2 are DiD/TWFE on branch-level data comparing 294 AI-treated and 115 control branches around one two-month pilot (January-February 2020); authors state 'the unique treatment time'. Only one adoption cohort, so not staggered. Specifications also use matching/IPW reweighting and time-varying covariates.
design_notes: Table 3 (two-period DiD, Study 1) and Table 4 (two-period DiD, Study 2) plus TWFE versions with bimonthly pre-periods (branch and period FE, clustered by branch or area, wild bootstrap). Reported TWFE ATETs: mortgage-grant ratio -0.056 (p<.001, branch clusters), defaulted payments -0.071 (p=.030). Also doubly robust IPW DiD (Sant'Anna-Zhao) and HonestDiD-style sensitivity (Roth 2022). Studies 3-4 are text analysis, survey and a preregistered experiment.
screener_notes: Text-only screen. No package_dir. Author statement: partially open data at Harvard Dataverse doi 10.7910/DVN/U96KIB; Study 4 public; Studies 1-3 are proprietary bank data, anonymized versions and syntax given only to the JMR Data Editor. Not eligible: single adoption date.
